source: Grimlite-Li 816d9cd: Grimoire/Networking/Handlers/HandlerDropItem.cs and Grimoire/Tools/Flash.cs:695-715; the envelope shape is Grimoire/Networking/JsonMessage.cs (Object["b"]["o"]).
note: The drop list reads one item per frame: the client takes items.First().Value, so these frames carry one item each, exactly as the reference reads them. iRty / iStk / sLink are carried because the game s own DFRAME item object has them.

frames.why: an AC, member-only item: bCoins and bUpg are the two BoolConverter fields DropUi draws as AC | Member
not a drop: a JSON frame whose cmd is something else
an XT frame: the % byte the relay also carries
the take succeeded: Flash.cs:690-693 removes the item from the stack on bSuccess == 1
the take failed (a full bag, or the item is already held): the row stays, as Game.as leaves it
